data.summary_en: REM (Reusable Experience Memory) manages experience-memory lifecycle in an agent’s think-act loop via three decisions: what to store, when to recall, what to forget. On SWE-ContextBench Lite, it outperforms existing memory systems—68.7% vs 55.6% match@1—raises task solve rate from 24.9% to 27.6%, cuts cost 17%.
